Environment.doc: What surrounds the scene: its name, the background and the ambient light.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The scene's name; `""` shows the name it was created with.

fields.name: background
fields.doc: Viewport background, `#rrggbb`.

fields.name: ambient_color
fields.doc: Ambient light colour, `#rrggbb`.

fields.name: ambient_intensity
fields.doc: Ambient light strength, 0 to 10.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Set by the contract.

Lock.doc: A check-out: one editor holding an asset until they check it in or it lapses.

fields.name: holder
fields.doc: Set by the contract.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc: After this (the holder's clock, unix milliseconds) the lock no longer holds.

fields.name: mine
fields.doc: Whether the caller holds it.

Material.doc: How an object's surface looks. A light reads `color` as its light colour.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Base colour, `#rrggbb`.

fields.name: metalness
fields.doc: 0 (dielectric) to 1 (metal).

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: 0 (mirror) to 1 (matte).

fields.name: opacity
fields.doc: 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque).

fields.name: emissive
fields.doc: Emitted colour, `#rrggbb`; `#000000` for none.

fields.name: wireframe
fields.doc: Draw the edges only.

fields.name: flat_shading
fields.doc: Faceted normals instead of smooth ones.

fields.name: base_color_map
fields.doc: Texture id for the base colour (sRGB), or `""`.

fields.name: normal_map
fields.doc: Texture id for the tangent-space normal map (OpenGL, +Y up), or `""`.

fields.name: normal_scale
fields.doc: Strength of the normal map, 0 to 10.

fields.name: orm_map
fields.doc:
Texture id packing occlusion (R), roughness (G) and metalness (B) — glTF's and
Unreal's layout — or `""`.

fields.name: emissive_map
fields.doc: Texture id for emission, or `""`.

Member.doc: Someone who has opened the scene, as they describe themselves.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The member's account id. Filled in from the slot on read; never trusted from storage.

MemberView.doc: A member with their effective role.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: `admin`, `editor` or `viewer`.

fields.name: initial_name
fields.doc:
What `init` was given. `Frozen`: nobody rewrites it. The environment's `name`
overrides it once an editor sets one.

fields.name: objects
fields.doc:
Every object, keyed by id. Writable only by accounts the editor role is
projected onto, on every node.

fields.name: meshes
fields.doc:
The current blob of every `mesh` object, keyed by the object's id. Guarded like
`objects`.

fields.name: textures
fields.doc: Every texture, keyed by id. Guarded like `objects`.

fields.name: history
fields.doc:
Every version of every mesh and texture, keyed
`"<asset>/<stamp:020>/<author>/<blob>"` so one asset's history is a prefix scan
in order. Guarded like `objects`.

fields.name: locks
fields.doc: Live and lapsed check-outs, keyed by asset id. Guarded like `objects`.

fields.name: environment
fields.doc: One entry, under [`ENVIRONMENT_KEY`]. Guarded like `objects`.

fields.name: members
fields.doc: One profile per account, written only by that account.

fields.name: roles
fields.doc: Admins (the creator) and editors.

MeshRef.doc:
The shape of a `mesh` object: a reference to the blob holding its vertices.

The blob is the app's binary mesh format (see the frontend's `meshcodec.ts`).
The contract cannot read it; `vertex_count` and friends are what the writer
says is inside, and a reader checks them against what it decodes.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The object this is the shape of.

fields.name: blob_id
fields.doc: The blob, as the 64-character hex id the node returned from the upload.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: The blob's length in bytes.

fields.name: has_uvs
fields.doc: Whether the mesh carries texture coordinates.

fields.name: author
fields.doc: Who wrote this version. Set by the contract.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: A note for the history ("retopo pass", "Restored v3"); may be empty.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Set by the contract; only ever grows.

SceneInfo.doc: The scene's header: name, environment, counts, and what the caller may do.

fields.name: me
fields.doc: The caller's account id.

fields.name: my_role
fields.doc: `admin`, `editor` or `viewer`.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Chosen by the caller; use a fresh UUID. Writing an existing id replaces that object.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Shown in the outliner.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: One of [`OBJECT_KINDS`]. A `mesh` takes its shape from `put_mesh` under the same id.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc:
The parent object's id, or `""` for a root object. A parent that does not exist, or
a chain that loops, reads as `""`.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Position relative to the parent, scene units.

fields.name: rotation
fields.doc: Euler rotation (XYZ order) relative to the parent, radians.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Scale relative to the parent. Primitives are unit-sized, so this is their size.

fields.name: visible
fields.doc: Hidden objects (and their children) are not drawn.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: Surface, or light colour for a light.

fields.name: segments
fields.doc: How finely a curved primitive is tessellated, 3 to 128. Ignored by other kinds.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: A light's strength; ignored by other kinds.

fields.name: created_by
fields.doc: Who first created it. Set by the contract; the value sent is ignored.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Creation time, unix milliseconds. Kept from the first write.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc:
Last change, unix milliseconds. The contract moves it past the stored value, so it
only ever grows; the value sent is a hint.

TextureRef.doc: An image a material can use, held in a blob.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Chosen by the caller; use a fresh UUID.

fields.name: blob_id
fields.doc: The blob, as a 64-character hex id.

fields.name: mime
fields.doc: `image/png`, `image/jpeg` or `image/webp`.

fields.name: color_space
fields.doc: `srgb` for colour, `linear` for data (normal, ORM).

fields.name: author
fields.doc: Set by the contract.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Set by the contract; only ever grows.

Vec3.doc: A point or a direction in scene units, or Euler angles in radians.

VersionRecord.doc:
One saved version of a mesh or a texture. Written once per write and never
changed; restoring writes a new one.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: The mesh's object id or the texture's id.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: `mesh` or `texture`.

fields.name: a
fields.doc: Vertices and triangles for a mesh; width and height for a texture.

VersionView.doc: One row of an asset's history, numbered from 1 in the order it was written.

fields.name: number
fields.doc: 1 for the first version. Derived from the history's order, never stored.

fields.name: a
fields.doc: Vertices (mesh) or width (texture).

fields.name: b
fields.doc: Triangles (mesh) or height (texture).

fields.name: current
fields.doc: Whether this is the blob the asset points at now.

methods.name: check_in
methods.doc:
Check assets back in. Editors may check in their own; an admin may release anyone's
(breaking a lock left by someone who is away). Ids not checked out are fine.

# Errors
Fails, releasing nothing, if the caller is not an editor, the batch is too large, or
a non-admin names someone else's check-out.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"]}
```

methods.name: check_out
methods.doc:
Check assets out, so nobody else can change them until the caller checks them in or
the check-out lapses. Editors only. Checking out something the caller already holds
extends it.

# Errors
Fails, checking out nothing, if the caller is not an editor, the batch is too large,
or one of them is checked out, live, by someone else.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"],"hours":8,"now":1727000000000}
```

params.name: ids
params.doc: object or texture ids, at most 200.

params.name: hours
params.doc: how long the check-out lasts, 1 to 168.

methods.name: clear_scene
methods.doc:
Remove every object, mesh, texture, version and check-out. Admin only. The blobs
themselves stay on the nodes that hold them.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: delete_objects
methods.doc:
Delete objects and their meshes. Editors only. Ids already gone are fine. Children
of a deleted object are not deleted — they read as root objects — so delete them in
the same call to remove a whole branch. A deleted mesh's history is kept, so an undo
can bring it back. Emits one `ObjectsDeleted` event.

# Errors
Fails, deleting nothing, if the caller is not an editor, the batch is too large, or
one of the objects is checked out by someone else.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"],"now":1727000000000}
```

params.name: now
params.doc: the caller's clock, unix milliseconds, for judging check-outs.

methods.name: delete_textures
methods.doc:
Delete textures. Editors only. Materials that name a deleted texture simply draw
without it. Their history is kept.

# Errors
Fails, deleting nothing, if the caller is not an editor, the batch is too large, or
one of them is checked out by someone else.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["tex-1"],"now":1727000000000}
```

params.name: now
params.doc: the caller's clock, unix milliseconds, for judging check-outs.

methods.name: get_members
methods.doc:
Everyone who has joined, with their effective role, oldest first. An admin or
editor who has never opened the scene is listed too, named by their id.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: get_objects
methods.doc:
Every object in the scene, with each `parent` resolved: a missing parent or a
loop reads as `""`. Ordered by creation, then id.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: get_objects_by_ids
methods.doc:
Several objects by id, in the order asked; unknown ids are left out. Parents are
returned as stored — resolve them against `get_objects`.

# Examples
```json
{"ids":["5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"]}
```

methods.name: get_scene
methods.doc:
The scene's name and environment, its size, and the caller's id and role.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: grant_editor
methods.doc:
Let a member change the scene. Admin only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin or `member` is not an account id.

# Examples
```json
{"member":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

params.name: member
params.doc: their member id (account id). They need not have joined yet.

methods.name: init
methods.doc:
Create a scene. Runs once, when the context is created; the creator becomes its
only admin and may grant others the editor role.

# Examples
```json
{"name":"Robot"}
```

methods.name: join
methods.doc:
Introduce the caller to the scene, or change the name they are shown by. Anyone in
the context may; it grants no editing rights.

# Examples
```json
{"name":"Ada","now":1727000000000}
```

params.name: name
params.doc: display name, at most 80 characters; empty becomes `"Guest"`.

methods.name: list_history
methods.doc:
Every saved version of one mesh or texture, oldest first and numbered from 1, with
the one in use marked `current`. At most the newest 500.

# Examples
```json
{"asset_id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90"}
```

params.name: asset_id
params.doc: a mesh object's id or a texture's id.

methods.name: list_locks
methods.doc:
Every check-out still live at `now`, ordered by asset id.

# Examples
```json
{"now":1727000000000}
```

methods.name: list_meshes
methods.doc:
Every mesh's current reference, ordered by id. A client compares each `blob_id`
with what it holds and downloads only the blobs it lacks.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: list_textures
methods.doc:
Every texture's current reference, ordered by name, then id.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: my_role
methods.doc:
The caller's effective role: `admin`, `editor` or `viewer`.

# Examples
```json
{}
```

methods.name: put_mesh
methods.doc:
Point a `mesh` object at a new blob of vertices, and record it as a new version.
Editors only. Upload the blob to the node first (with this context's id, so it is
announced); write the object before or with it — a mesh with no object is stored but
drawn by nobody.

To restore an earlier version, write its `blob_id` (from `list_history`) again.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor, the mesh is checked out by someone else, the
blob id is not 64 hex characters, or a count or size is over its limit.

# Examples
```json
{"mesh":{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","blob_id":"4f9c3d1e2b7a8c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d","size":180,"vertex_count":3,"triangle_count":1,"has_uvs":false,"author":"","message":"blockout","updated_at":0},"now":1727000000000}
```

params.name: mesh
params.doc: the reference; `author` and `updated_at` are set by the contract. At most 4 000 000 vertices, 8 000 000 triangles and 512 MiB.

methods.name: put_objects
methods.doc:
Add objects, or replace the objects with the same ids. Editors only. Emits one
`ObjectsChanged` event.

Each object's `created_by` and `created_at` are kept from the first write;
`updated_at` is the caller's `now`, moved past the stored value.

# Errors
Fails, writing nothing, if the caller is not an editor, the batch is too large, the
scene would exceed 2000 objects, an object is checked out by someone else, or an
object is malformed (unknown kind, a non-finite number, a bad colour, a texture id
that is too long, an object parented to itself).

# Examples
```json
{"objects":[{"id":"5f0c2b9e-8c1a-4d3e-9b7f-2a6d1e4c8b90","name":"Cube","kind":"cube","parent":"","position":{"x":0,"y":0.5,"z":0},"rotation":{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0},"scale":{"x":1,"y":1,"z":1},"visible":true,"material":{"color":"#c8ccd4","metalness":0,"roughness":0.6,"opacity":1,"emissive":"#000000","wireframe":false,"flat_shading":false,"base_color_map":"","normal_map":"","normal_scale":1,"orm_map":"","emissive_map":""},"segments":32,"intensity":0,"created_by":"","created_at":0,"updated_at":0}],"now":1727000000000}
```
methods.returns_doc: The ids written, in the order given.

methods.name: put_texture
methods.doc:
Add a texture, or point an existing one at a new image, and record it as a new
version. Editors only. Upload the image blob first, with this context's id.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor, the texture is checked out by someone else,
the scene already holds 1 000 textures, the blob id is not 64 hex characters, the
mime type or colour space is not one this app knows, or a size is over its limit.

# Examples
```json
{"texture":{"id":"tex-1","name":"Crate albedo","blob_id":"4f9c3d1e2b7a8c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d","size":524288,"width":2048,"height":2048,"mime":"image/png","color_space":"srgb","author":"","message":"","updated_at":0},"now":1727000000000}
```

params.name: texture
params.doc: the reference; `author` and `updated_at` are set by the contract. At most 16 384 pixels a side and 512 MiB.

methods.name: revoke_editor
methods.doc:
Make a member a viewer again. Admin only; an admin's own role is unaffected.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an admin or `member` is not an account id.

# Examples
```json
{"member":"<member id from get_members>"}
```

methods.name: set_environment
methods.doc:
Rename the scene, or change its background or ambient light. Editors only.

# Errors
Fails if the caller is not an editor, or a colour is not `#rrggbb`.

# Examples
```json
{"environment":{"name":"Robot","background":"#1d1f24","ambient_color":"#ffffff","ambient_intensity":0.4,"updated_at":0},"now":1727000000000}
```

params.name: environment
params.doc: the whole environment; `updated_at` is set by the contract.

events.name: EnvironmentChanged
events.doc: The name, background or ambient light changed.

events.name: LocksChanged
events.doc: Assets were checked out or in; the payload is their ids.

events.name: MemberChanged
events.doc: A member joined or renamed themselves; the payload is their member id.

events.name: MeshChanged
events.doc: A mesh's vertices changed; the payload is its object id.

events.name: ObjectsChanged
events.doc: Objects were added or changed; the payload is their ids.

events.name: ObjectsDeleted
events.doc: Objects were deleted; the payload is the ids the call named.

events.name: RoleChanged
events.doc: A member's role changed; the payload is the id the caller passed.

events.name: TextureChanged
events.doc: A texture was added or replaced; the payload is its id.

events.name: TexturesDeleted
events.doc: Textures were deleted; the payload is the ids the call named.
